script.source:
//@version=5
indicator("uct-sma-ema-parity-v1", overlay=false)
sma20 = ta.sma(close, 20)
ema20 = ta.ema(close, 20)
plot(sma20, title="sma20")
plot(ema20, title="ema20")

provenance.note: Captured via CSV export (Table view -> Download data) of a real SPY Daily chart with a live ta.sma(close,20)/ta.ema(close,20) indicator added, full double-precision floats. 2,031 real trading-day bars (2018-08-07..2026-09-04), ALL rows from the true period-warmup onward carry a real vendor value. SMA is a memoryless (finite-impulse) rolling mean -- it depends ONLY on the trailing 20 bars, so unlike the Wilder/RMA-recursive rsi/atr functions it carries NO capture-window seed-convergence lag: verified empirically, every bar from index 19 (the true period-warmup boundary) onward agrees with the real vendor immediately.

_vendor_parity_warmup_bars_note: 19 IS the true, full semantic period-warmup for sma(close,20) -- no additional seed-convergence-lag margin is needed, confirmed empirically (see report): SMA has no memory beyond its own window, so a capture-window cold start cannot occur the way it does for a recursive smoother.
